title: An acceptance carrying an explicit empty `overrides` map
why: `{}` and an absent key mean the same scope: the default frame, no overrides. The comparison here carries `{}` too, so both spellings of 'nothing' meet — and an engine keying on presence rather than on the entries reports `out-of-scope` for a record that names exactly this comparison. The matching and mismatching override cases beside this one both use non-empty maps, so neither reaches the empty one.
